evals.prompt: I want to try the kafka recipe from the Spice cookbook on my laptop. What do I need, and what are the steps?
evals.expected_output: Needs Docker and the cookbook checkout; docker compose up -d (or make) in cookbook/kafka, spice run, query with spice sql, then docker compose down / make clean

assertions.name: starts_compose_stack
assertions.description: Should start the recipe's Docker Compose stack

assertions.name: runs_spice
assertions.description: Should start the runtime with spice run

assertions.name: explains_cleanup
assertions.description: Should say how to stop the containers afterwards

evals.prompt: I'm running the cookbook's ai recipe. OPENAI_API_KEY is exported in my shell, but the gpt-4o-mini model still fails to authenticate. Why?
evals.expected_output: The recipe reads ${secrets:SPICE_OPENAI_API_KEY}, which resolves SPICE_OPENAI_API_KEY, not OPENAI_API_KEY; set SPICE_OPENAI_API_KEY in .env.local or export it

assertions.name: names_spice_prefixed_variable
assertions.description: Should identify SPICE_OPENAI_API_KEY as the variable the recipe reads

evals.prompt: On Spice v2.1.1 I put my real OpenAI key in .env.local for the cookbook's search recipe, but the runtime still logs 'Incorrect API key provided: <your op***'. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: On v2.1.x, values in .env override .env.local and exported variables, so the recipe's tracked .env placeholder wins; put the key in .env (don't commit it), delete the placeholder line, or upgrade to v2.2.0+

assertions.name: blames_env_precedence
assertions.description: Should explain that the .env placeholder takes precedence over .env.local

assertions.name: names_fixed_version
assertions.description: Should say the behavior was fixed in v2.2.0 (upgrade path)

evals.prompt: Port 8090 is already used by another app on my machine. How do I run a Spice cookbook recipe on different ports and still query it?
evals.expected_output: spice run --http-endpoint 127.0.0.1:<port> --flight-endpoint 127.0.0.1:<port> (not spice run -- --http, which fails), then spice sql --endpoint grpc://127.0.0.1:<flight-port> and adjust README commands that hardcode 8090/50051

assertions.name: uses_flight_endpoint_flag
assertions.description: Should also move the Flight port with --flight-endpoint

assertions.name: points_client_at_new_port
assertions.description: Should point spice sql at the new Flight port

evals.prompt: Can you run the recipe from spiceai/cookbook PR #365 so I can check it before it merges?
evals.expected_output: Fetch the PR head (cookbook.sh fetch --pr 365, git fetch origin pull/365/head, or gh pr checkout 365), find the recipes it changes, then check prerequisites and run

assertions.name: fetches_pr_head
assertions.description: Should check out the pull request's head

evals.prompt: The evals recipe in the Spice cookbook fails on my v2.3.1 runtime with an error about the evals section. Is the recipe broken?
evals.expected_output: The recipe is marked Deprecated in v2.0+: the evals subsystem was removed in v2.0.0, so it only runs on a v1.x runtime

assertions.name: explains_removal
assertions.description: Should explain that evals were removed in v2.0.0

assertions.name: points_to_v1
assertions.description: Should say the recipe needs a v1.x runtime
